article.title: The best guitar music from 2021
article.excerpt: Two new boxed sets are not only among the best releases of the year, they are some of the best guitar recordings of all time. The first is Doc Watson: Life’s Work A Retrospective , four CDs of wonder and much better than any other Watson collection.
